text: Two dice are thrown simultaneously. Find the probability that the product of the numbers appearing on them is a prime number.

meta.heading: Mathematics Standard (041) Sample Question Paper 2026-27 · Q25
meta.extractiveQuote: Two dice are thrown simultaneously. Find the probability that the product of the numbers appearing on them is a prime number.

text: There are 36 equally likely outcomes. The favourable ordered pairs are (1,2), (1,3), (1,5), (2,1), (3,1), and (5,1), so the probability is 6/36 = 1/6.

(B) chemical change because wavelength of reflected light changes.
(C) physical change because the space between crystals is adjusted.
(D) physical change because light is reflected by crystals.
